posts.title_en: I'm the one who said Scorpion doesn't take crit damage
posts.summary_en: The poster who claimed Scorpion's poison can't crit says he found no crit formula in the client's data files and asks where it is. 초코초코케이크 answers that the crit and crit-damage calculation lives in the APK's native library (lib_burst_generated.so), not in the data sets, and gives the code addresses for the poison tick, damage calculation, crit roll and crit multiplier; the poison's IsWeakEffect flag doesn't appear to cancel crit damage. The poster accepts it.
mechanics: Scorpion's poison ticks go through the normal crit roll and crit-damage multiplier (stated from a decompile of lib_burst_generated.so; addresses given).
disagreements: The original 'no crit' poster couldn't find the formula in the data files; the decompiler places it in native code.

quotes.kr: 치명타 계산식은 data 폴더의 patch binary set이나 entity binary set에 있는 게 아니라, APK 내부의 lib_burst_generated.so에 있음
quotes.en: The crit formula isn't in the data folder's patch or entity binary sets; it's in lib_burst_generated.so inside the APK

quotes.kr: 독에 설정된 IsWeakEffect도 확인했는데, 치명타 피해를 무효화하는 조건은 아닌듯
quotes.en: I checked the poison's IsWeakEffect too; it doesn't seem to be a condition that cancels crit damage

mechanics: Scorpion's poison crits (stated, datamine to follow).
